results.title: 10-K 1 form10k.htm DORMAN PRODUCTS 10-K 12-30-2006
results.snippet: The 2006 10-K describes end users as two groups, individual consumers, who purchase parts to perform "do-it-yourself" repairs on their own vehicles; and (ii) professional installers. It also notes that the individual consumer market is typically supplied through retailers and through the retail arms of warehouse distributors.
